title: Having and needing
description: Say what you have, what you want, and what you must do.
grammarNote: Tener has irregular forms: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tenéis, tienen.

items.note: An infinitive. Its forms are irregular: tengo, tienes, tiene.
An infinitive. Its forms are irregular: quiero, quieres, quiere.
An infinitive. Its forms are irregular: puedo, puedes, puede.
An infinitive. Its forms are irregular: debo, debes, debe.
There is, there are. It never changes form.
Feminine: la hambre. You say tener hambre.
Feminine: la sed. You say tener sed.
Masculine: el sueño. You say tener sueño.
Masculine: el miedo. You say tener miedo.
No article: esto gana. It also means wins.
